An Arts venue with an unique energy

The Courtyard Theatre is a cultural hub for anything you put your imagination to...

The Courtyard Theatre is an artistic resource providing a platform for theatre, music, visual art, independent film and has rehearsal space,facilities for corporate use and event hire.
